thread.title: Back in December 2017, I published an article about Universa

author: Mehdi Zare
title: Back in December 2017, I published an article about Universa
text:
Back in December 2017, I published an article about Universal Display Corporation (NASDAQ: OLED ) and concluded that the future of the company relies on its relationship with Samsung ( OTC:SSNLF ).
We have heard several good news since last December, and it should have increased the overall confidence of investors in the future of the company, which was the case till January 18th, 2018.
OLED data by YCharts 
However, speculation on the next move by Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) and ambiguity about its decision to use LCD displays in some models had a strong negative impact and moved OLED down by about 20% in just five trading days.
Let's go through the new information we have received since December and then update the underlying assumptions for DCF model to get a current estimate on the intrinsic value of OLED.
Tax Reform The average tax rate for OLED over the last two years was about 28.2%, and we know that the majority of its income is generated through licensing its patents to foreign companies.
